name: clean-human-text
must: Returns the text unchanged or with one or two small edits
Says nothing needed fixing, or lists at most one change with a reason
must_not: Adds a greeting, sign-off or new fact

name: linkedin-slop-post
must: Keeps 42, 9 and two weeks
Removes the setup, the not-just contrast, the group of three, the tapestry line, the farmed question and the hashtag block
Adds no new number, story or claim
must_not: Invents a personal story or a result

name: numbers-urls-quote
must: Keeps 12 May, 3 days, 118 pages, 90 days, the URL and the quote word for word

name: check-only
request: Check this draft for AI patterns. Do not rewrite it.
must: Each finding quotes a line and names the pattern
Findings are ordered most serious first
Ends with one sentence: clear problem or judgment call
Does not say or guess that an AI wrote it
must_not: Returns a rewritten version of the text

name: non-english
must: States that the tell rules are for English
Stays in German
Keeps 230 and März
Does not add facts

name: mixed-spelling
must: Notices the mix of UK and US spelling
Either unifies to one variety and says which, or flags the mix
Asks no question
must_not: Asks the user which spelling to use

name: cold-email
request: Rewrite this cold email. Facts you may use: Dev builds invoice-matching automation. Priya runs finance operations at Northwind.
must: Cuts the sender-focused opener
Cuts or flags the claim about the company's growth, since no source is given
Ends with one clear ask
Uses only the facts given
must_not: Invents a detail about Northwind or Priya
Keeps the praise as a fact

name: landing-page-claims
must: Flags or removes 'world's best', 'trusted by thousands' and '10x' as unsupported
Keeps the free trial offer
must_not: Writes a new claim, number or customer count in their place

name: docs-readme
must: Removes simply, it's easy, please note and in order to
Keeps Node 18, 100 requests per second, the command and the code block exactly

name: code-block
must: Code block is unchanged byte for byte
Opening and closing leftovers are removed

name: chatbot-leftovers
request: Rewrite this bio for a website.
must: Removes the greeting, the 'as an AI' line and the closing offer
Flags the placeholders and does not fill them
Removes the tracking parameter from the link
must_not: Invents a name or a city

name: no-draft-non-interactive
request: Write a Slack message telling the team the deploy moved to Thursday. That is all I know. You cannot ask me anything.
must: Asks no question
Gives a short message
States at most one assumption in one line
must_not: Invents a reason, a time or a name
Opens with a greeting aimed at the reader such as 'Hope everyone is well'

name: batch-sameness
request: These five posts go out this week. Rewrite them.
must: The five posts do not share one opener
Each keeps its own topic and its claim
Adds no number or new fact
must_not: Leaves four or five posts opening with the same words

name: voice-slot
request: Rewrite this post. Voice note from the writer: I write in short stacked fragments on purpose. Keep them. I end posts with a one-line lesson.
must: Keeps the fragments
Keeps the one-line lesson
Changes little or nothing
must_not: Merges the fragments into long sentences

name: single-tell
must: Leaves the text alone or makes one small edit
Does not treat one 'crucial' and one dash as a problem on their own
